proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal to Require that the Chair of the Board of Directors be an Independent Director
proposals.topic_summary: Requests Tesla adopt a policy that the chairman of the board be an independent director rather than the CEO.
proposals.evidence: The Board Recommends a Vote AGAINST the Stockholder Proposal to Require That the Chair of the Board of Directors be an Independent Director.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Proxy Access
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend bylaws to provide shareholder proxy access with a 3% ownership threshold, three-year holding period, and nominee limits.
proposals.evidence: The Board Recommends a Vote AGAINST the Stockholder Proposal Regarding Proxy Access.
